name: Fixed fare means the route did not change the amount
statement: If the pricing mode is FIXED_AT_BOOKING and the fare charged equals the quoted fare, a longer route did not change what the rider paid: no fare refund. The deviation is recorded as driver-conduct information only.

sources.quote: The trip fare is fixed based on pick-up and drop-off points, hence the driver may decide to take the most efficient route according to GPS.
Fares quoted for our services are generally fixed, except for RydeTAXI.
